Name: AhCuteArt's Color Themed Sprinklers
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Another color-themed project done! I didn't intend to finish this up, but the designs were done... so all I had to do were the recolors and the coding. Well, with my wrist giving me issues this week, recolors and code were just what the doctor ordered. LOL. [/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]I made this project because I didn't care for the look of the current sprinklers, and other mods didn't fit the color theme I was going for in my own saves. So here we are. I was going to draw up a potion bottle, but they didn't look right within such a tiny space. So I went for some glass liquid orbs thingy instead. For those of you who love modding and decorating SDv, I hope you enjoy these. [/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Current Colors: Black, Blue, Red, White, Green, Grey, Orange, Purple, Yellow,  Baby Blue, Buttermilk, Lilac, Marigold, Mint, Pink, and Chocolate[/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Recolors: Vanilla, Earthy, VPR, Blue Grass (If there is another recolor you would like me to add, let me know.)[/b][/color]

[size=4][b]Installation [/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1.﻿Choose one of the files or all of them. (Both the CP and AT files work together or separately) 
2.﻿Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][CP File] This file will change all vanilla sprinklers into a themed type and color. Go into the GMCM and look for [b](CP) AhCuteArt Colored Glass Sprinklers[/b] to change the color and gate type options you want. 

[AT File] This file will change sprinklers into whatever color you want. Make sure to buy the paint bucket from Robin to be able to edit your sprinklers. Each one is separated by its recolor. You can download as many as you like since they can work individually or together. [/color]

[size=4][b]Compatibility [/b][/size]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]This should work in every language. (I hope)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]The CP file might clash with other mods that edit sprinklers, but the AT file will work with anything. [/color]
